models.title: Qwen3 1.7B
models.description: Best balance of speed and quality on most phones. Good at following instructions and summarizing sources.

models.title: Qwen2.5 0.5B
models.description: Tiny and fast. Works on older or low-memory phones; answers are simpler.

models.title: Llama 3.2 1B
models.description: Meta's small model. Fast, friendly tone, decent general knowledge.

models.title: Gemma 3 1B
models.description: Google's small model. Good writing quality for its size.

models.title: Llama 3.2 3B
models.description: Noticeably smarter than the 1B models. Needs a recent phone with 6 GB+ RAM.

models.title: Qwen3 4B Instruct
models.description: Highest quality that fits on a phone. Flagship phones with 8 GB+ RAM only; slower.

models.title: Nomic Embed Text v1.5
models.description: Search model for your notes and documents (the same one Project NOMAD uses). Small; recommended alongside any chat model.

tools.title: CyberChef
tools.description: GCHQ's 'cyber Swiss Army knife': encoding, encryption, hashing, compression, data analysis. Apache-2.0.

tools.title: IT-Tools
tools.description: Dozens of handy utilities: converters, generators, network calculators, formatters. GPL-3.0.
